Third-party libraries (MIT licensed), vendored so the site needs no build step:

- three.js r170 — `three.module.min.js` — https://threejs.org (LICENSE-three.txt)
- chess.js 1.0.0 — `chess.js` — https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js (LICENSE-chess.js.txt)

The 3D chess pieces are procedurally generated in `static/js/chess/pieces.js`; no external models are used.
The game shown is the public-domain "Opera Game" (Morphy, 1858).
